title: Azusawa Kohane — Chasing After Everyone〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Shinonome and Aoyagi are so good...
But...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing with everyone like this really is the best. It's just so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, I felt the same way when...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this might be a good place to stop for today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds good! See you all here tomorrow then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, about tomorrow's practice...
Would it be okay if we did it somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's a park nearby with really beautiful cherry blossoms and I sang with my friends there the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was hoping that we could try singing there too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Practicing under the cherry blossoms? That sounds fun! We can have a look around too while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, don't tell me you've never gone to see them before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, seriously?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He did mention that he didn't have much time to play with friends or go to school events since he was so busy learning classical music from his father every day...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But cherry blossoms too...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Since we all have tomorrow off, why don't we start practice early and have a little picnic under the cherry blossoms after we're done?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm totally up for that!
What about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. I'm interested in what we'll actually do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As long as we get a good practice in, I don't care either way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great! I'll make us some food!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'll bring some snacks and stuff!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys get us some drinks. Anything from the convenience store should work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait!)
The next day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone, over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, these trees are huge!
And they're in full bloom!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They are... This is nice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started with practice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew... That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it felt good to practice in a place where we can sing as loud as we wanted for a change.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. With beautiful cherry blossoms in the background too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? That felt so amazing! Thanks for suggesting this to us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're all enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, it's time for our little picnic!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah! Oh, here...
My mom and I made some rice balls together for today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, are they all seasoned like this?! They're so cute and colorful!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As long as they're good, I don't care...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you have any carrot flavored ones, Kohane? We can make him eat those if you do!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha... I'm not sure I've ever heard of carrot-flavored rice balls...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
I brought this with me too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A camera?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I borrowed my dad's DSLR to take some photos of the cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I even brought a tripod, so we can take a commemorative photo together too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right... We haven't taken a picture together yet, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. It'd be nice to have even just one. We could use it for flyers and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're right. Some people have been asking us if we have any pictures they can have so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey! Can you guys stand a little closer together? A little more in the middle of the tree if you can...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All I have to do is set the timer and...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! You stand here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Say cheese!
